blocks.content: Quiz: The user changes the status filter from open to done. What does React Query do?
Tap an option below to answer:
It returns the cached open tasks because nothing changed in the component
The component re-rendered but React Query only cares about the key, not the component.
The component re-rendered but React Query only cares about the key, not the component.
It fetches fresh data because the query key changed
Correct. taskKeys.list({ status: 'done' }) is a different key from taskKeys.list({ status: 'open' }) so React Query fetches new data.
Correct. taskKeys.list({ status: 'done' }) is a different key from taskKeys.list({ status: 'open' }) so React Query fetches new data.
It throws an error because two different keys can't share the same queryFn
Different keys can absolutely share the same queryFn. The key and the function are independent.
Different keys can absolutely share the same queryFn. The key and the function are independent.
It merges the open and done tasks into one list
React Query never merges data from different keys. Each key has its own separate cache entry.
React Query never merges data from different keys. Each key has its own separate cache entry.
